newsitem.title: USA: Derma Sciences to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Derma Sciences to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Derma Sciences Inc said on Tuesday that it will take a charge against fourth quarter earnings of $250,000 for restructuring, an $82,589 charge for indefinitely deferring plans to construct a new headquarters facility and a $179,688 charge to write down obsolete inventories.

Derma said that it is consolidating its marketing, sales and distribution functions under the company's president, John Borthwick, and eliminating the positions of vice president for sales and marketing, director of purchasing and director of international development, together with several support positions.
The company said it is also evaluating its selling and distribution network and implementing changes to improve market share.

According to the company, savings resulting from the restructuring, exclusive of budgetary revisions, are expected to total about $500,000 in 1997, or 11 percent of its 1996 selling, general and administrative expense.
